notes: Format Premiere - Tatooine: posted 17 June 2001, before Coruscant, and the list has no Coruscant-set card.

No Objective. Starting cards as posted under 'Starting (7)': Hoth Shield Generator, Hoth 4th Marker, Podrace Prep, Tatooine Podrace Arena, Boonta Eve Podrace, Anakin's Podracer, A New Secret Base; these count toward the 60. A New Secret Base deploys on the 1st marker, so Hoth: Main Power Generators (1st Marker) is the starting location.

Posted 'Hoth Shield Generator' dested Hoth: Main Power Generators (1st Marker) (the energy-shield site; A New Secret Base deploys on the 1st marker); 'Hoth 4th Marker' dested Hoth: North Ridge (4th Marker); 'Hoth War Room' dested Hoth: Echo Command Center (War Room); 'Hoth DB' dested Hoth: Echo Docking Bay.

Posted 'Obi-Wan's BOOMSTICK', 'Luke's BOOMSTICK', 'Anakin's BOOMSTICK' and 'Qui-Gon's BOOMSTICK' dested Obi-Wan's Lightsaber, Luke's Lightsaber, Anakin's Lightsaber and Qui-Gon Jinn's Lightsaber: the strategy names the lightsabers ('3 lightsabers in a battle', 'drain adders from Lightsabers') and the description quotes Army of Darkness ('this is my BOOMSTICK').
Posted 'I Did It---(You can do it)', 'Obi-Wan's Journal ---(...)' and 'Gold Leader in Gold 1---(...)': the poster's comments after the dashes were dropped from the card names.

Posted 'Liea w/ Rifle' dested Leia With Blaster Rifle; 'Han w/ Blaster' dested Han With Heavy Blaster Pistol; 'Lando w/ Axe' dested Lando With Vibro-Ax; 'Jedi Knight Luke' dested Luke Skywalker, Jedi Knight; 'Intruuder Missle' dested Intruder Missile; 'Dagobah' dested the Light Dagobah system; Weapon Levitation dested the Light Jabba's Palace interrupt.
The 'Other Locations (4)' header was mis-parsed as a card and removed. Total 60.
